title: Remove the stale notice for the former Earcut bundle
description:
Fixes #16.

Remove the notice for the former Earcut bundle. Commit 16ac72c removed the bundled header and its wrapper. The notice was the sole remaining Earcut or Mapbox reference in the current tree. [Removal commit](https://github.com/thomasp85/transformr/commit/16ac72c88ac43c2236d8b8210606d66cb803405e)

Built the source archive before and after the change. The archive now omits `LICENSE.note` and retains the same `LICENSE` file and MIT license declaration. The package compiled and `R CMD check --no-manual` passed, including examples.

Prepared with Codex and checked in a separate Codex review.
